_comment: This repo's `./dev.sh check`, in parts, run by devtools/parts.py (the shared runner the parts component renders; its docstring is the format). A test part (one per tests/test_*.py) reads the whole repo but the other test modules and TODO.md; a gate part (`./dev.sh <gate>`, one per gate dev.sh dispatches but check, test and plans) reads the whole repo. A part that reads what no files list can name says `always`, so --resume never skips it: every module that runs ./setup on a scratch repo does (setup resolves its dependencies -- tools/hooks, tools/checks, the docs reader -- in the workspace around this repo), and so does every gate but files. tests/test_vocab.py (DevSh) holds this file to the test modules and to dev.sh's gates. A part tagged `full` (PLAN-check-progress.md §13: over the 300s budget alone in the runner's record) runs only under `./dev.sh check --full`; tests/test_vocab.py holds the tagged set to the one CLAUDE.md names.
